title: lepisorus sinensis
intro: Lepisorus sinensis, commonly known as the Chinese cliff fern, is a type of fern native to China. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lepisorus sinensis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lepisorus sinensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
